bio.text: Erik Underwood is a candidate for governor of Colorado in 2026 on the Approval Voting Party line, on a joint ticket with Frank Atwood.

According to his campaign website, he grew up in housing projects, has worked in the U.S. Senate in Washington, D.C., and chairs Illmatic Ventures and is chief executive of My24HourNews.com and Vurbil.
The site says he spent eight years in federal court litigation against Bank of America.
